resum: A positive week for stock markets despite the Nvidia shake-up: the S&P 500 gained 2.5%, the Nasdaq 2.3%, Europe's Stoxx 600 2.4% and Spain's Ibex 3.36%, to 20,020 points. The big story: Nvidia fell below $4 trillion in value for the first time since July 2025, and next week brings its results (Tuesday) and Anthropic's stock market debut (Thursday).
destacat: The S&P 500 gaining 2.5% in the same week that Nvidia, one of its biggest companies, was sinking shows that an index is far more than a single company: spreading risk across many softens the blows.
